<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="bg" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#181A20"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#262A34"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="avatar" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#C393FF"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="button" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#A06AF9"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FBA3FF"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="8" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".28"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="url(#bg)"/>
  <circle cx="352" cy="104" r="72" fill="#A06AF9" opacity=".06"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="692" r="92" fill="#FBA3FF" opacity=".035"/>

  <!-- status bar -->
  <text x="22" y="25" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>

  <line x1="307" y1="17" x2="307" y2="24" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <rect x="371" y="18" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <polyline points="31,61 23,69 31,77" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="24" y1="69" x2="43" y2="69" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <line x1="22" y1="94" x2="368" y2="94" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- avatar -->
  <circle cx="195" cy="137" r="48" fill="#000000" opacity=".24"/>

  <circle cx="195" cy="119" r="14" fill="#200E32"/>

  <line x1="222" y1="165" x2="236" y2="165" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="229" y1="158" x2="229" y2="172" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="195" y="204" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FBA3FF">Change photo</text>

  <!-- labels -->
  <text x="24" y="226" font-family="Inter" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="24" dy="0">Full name</tspan>
    <tspan x="24" dy="82">Email address</tspan>
    <tspan x="24" dy="82">Password</tspan>
    <tspan x="24" dy="82">Role</tspan>
    <tspan x="24" dy="82">About me</tspan>
  </text>

  <!-- fields shadows -->
  <rect x="22" y="237" width="346" height="48" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity=".22"/>
  <rect x="22" y="319" width="346" height="48" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity=".22"/>

  <rect x="22" y="565" width="346" height="76" rx="12" fill="#000000" opacity=".22"/>

  <rect x="22" y="235" width="346" height="48" rx="12" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="22" y="317" width="346" height="48" rx="12" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="22" y="399" width="346" height="48" rx="12" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="22" y="481" width="346" height="48" rx="12" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>
  <rect x="22" y="563" width="346" height="76" rx="12" fill="#262A34" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>

  <text x="38" y="265" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Maya Thompson</text>

  <text x="38" y="429" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">••••••••••••</text>
  <circle cx="345" cy="423" r="7" fill="none" stroke="#828282" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="339" y1="429" x2="351" y2="417" stroke="#828282" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <text x="38" y="591" font-family="Inter" font-size="14" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">
    <tspan x="38" dy="0">Building thoughtful digital products and</tspan>
    <tspan x="38" dy="22">helping teams turn ideas into impact.</tspan>
  </text>
  <text x="24" y="658" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#828282">Your profile details are visible to your team members.</text>

  <!-- done button -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="22" y="676" width="346" height="50" rx="14" fill="url(#button)"/>
    <text x="195" y="708" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="16" font-weight="700" fill="#200E32">Done</text>
  </g>

  <!-- bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="744" width="390" height="80" fill="#181A20" opacity=".96"/>
  <line x1="22" y1="744" x2="368" y2="744" stroke="#434343" stroke-width="1"/>

    <line x1="12" y1="20" x2="12" y2="24" stroke="#5E6272" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <text x="51" y="793" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Inter" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#5E6272">
    <tspan x="51" dy="0">Home</tspan>
    <tspan x="129" dy="0">Projects</tspan>
    <tspan x="206" dy="0" fill="#FBA3FF">Profile</tspan>
    <tspan x="284" dy="0">Settings</tspan>
  </text>
  <rect x="146" y="818" width="98" height="4" rx="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
</svg>
